LanguageData.KR_LetterText: The dark archotech watches every kill, and your struggle amuses it greatly. This boon is yours. Claim it — and try to stay alive.
LanguageData.KR_RewardResearchDesc: It sears knowledge straight into your scholars' minds. Instantly complete one available research project.
LanguageData.KR_RewardSkillDesc: It plucks the strings of nerve and muscle. Choose a pawn; one of their skills gains 3 levels.
LanguageData.KR_RewardItemDesc: It casts provisions from the void. Choose an item and a drop cell to receive a full stack.
LanguageData.KR_Claimed: The boon is granted. It is still watching. Keep it entertained.
LanguageData.KR_NoPending: It has no boon for you yet. Slaughter is prayer.
LanguageData.KR_SettingEnabledDesc: Master switch. When off, kills grant no progress and the main button is hidden — no need to remove the mod from your mod list.
LanguageData.KR_SettingInitialDesc: Kills required for the first reward tier.
LanguageData.KR_SettingFactorDesc: In exponential mode, each tier costs this factor times the previous one.
LanguageData.KR_SettingIncrementDesc: In linear mode, each tier costs this many more kills than the previous one.
LanguageData.KR_PickCell: Click a cell to deliver the goods
LanguageData.KR_ItemDelivered: The gift from the void has arrived.
